name: @jacky402615/dingtalkbot
description: DingTalk chat gateway: Stream-mode transport + OpenAPI reply

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outdir=dist --external dingtalk-stream && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('dist/cli.js','#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync('dist/cli.js','utf8'))" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
